note: Следов поставок не найдено. The name in the customs data belongs to a Russian importer, ENGIBOW ENTERPRISE LLC (Nizhny Novgorod, Delovaya St. 22, office 410/32), which buys Indian cutting tools (HS 82090010) from suppliers such as ALKRONA, UNICORN ENGINEERING SOLUTION, KTA SPINDLE TOOLINGS and SHRAMIK via Ahmedabad air. That is a buyer record, not evidence of an Indian supplier called EngiBow Enterprise. Declared HS codes 820411/820740/820750/820770 (hand tools, milling/interchangeable tooling) do not match the observed 82090010 (tool inserts/plates) — per project rules this is not a rejection ground, only a note. No CIN, PAN, GSTIN or state could be verified; all such fields are null. Verdict: no export shipments and no domestic supply traces found for the claimed Indian company; the entity may be a trading intermediary or a name confusion with the Russian LLC — recommend requesting the actual Indian legal name, GSTIN and one invoice before any engagement.
